_instructions: Copy to clients/<client-name>.json. Paste each answer from the Client Questionnaire doc into the matching field (Q numbers below). Leave blanks blank. Then run scripts/setup-client.ts.
locationId: PASTE the GHL location id (from the GHL web address: /v2/location/<this>/...)

questions.AI Business Name: Q1: Business name, exactly as customers should see it
questions.AI Services Not Offered: Q4: Jobs you don't do (the assistant will politely decline these)
questions.AI Service Area: Q5: Suburbs, postcodes or region you cover
questions.AI Outside Area: Q6: What should the assistant say to leads outside your area?
questions.AI After Hours: Q8: Do you take after-hours or emergency work? Any extra charge?
questions.AI After Hours Callbacks: Q9: If someone asks for a call outside your hours, what should we tell them?
questions.AI Pricing: Q11: Any call-out fee or prices the assistant may mention
questions.AI Job Length: Q12: How long does a typical quote or visit take?
questions.AI Notice Needed: Q13: How much notice do you need for a booking?
questions.AI Qualifying Questions: Q14: Extra questions to ask every lead
questions.AI Options: Q15: Should leads be offered a callback, a booked visit, or both?
questions.AI Alert Mobile: Q17: Mobile number(s) to text when a lead books or asks for a callback
questions.AI Emergencies: Q18: What counts as an emergency for you?
questions.AI Emergency Contacts: Q19: Who should be alerted for emergencies?
questions.AI Tone: Q20: Tone: casual or formal? Any words to use or avoid?
questions.AI FAQs: Q24: Common questions customers ask, and your answers
questions.AI Extra Info: Anything else the assistant should know (optional)
questions.AI Calendar ID: GHL calendar ID for bookings (filled in during setup from Q16's Google account)
